item.title: a short note about speakable content
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to speakable content, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Speakable content shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: speakable content, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: speakable content is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Speakable content shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: the case for speakable content
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on speakable content, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Speakable content shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
